stops.note: to write before, to lay down in advance, from prae- (before) and scribere (to write)
stops.meaning: to write beforehand, to lay down rules

stops.note: settled as the English word for recommending a treatment, or laying down a rule
stops.meaning: to recommend a treatment, or to lay down a rule

current_meaning: to recommend a medical treatment, or to lay down a rule or guideline
